subject: general
question: The people of Sikkim are known for their wonderful mask dance. What is this form of dance called in Sikkim?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chaam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Singhi Chaam or the Snow Lion Dance:

 
 
• Singhi Chaam or the Snow Lion or Kanchendzonga is a lion dance form in Sikkim.
 
• In Singhi Chaam dance, dancers perform in a lion costume that represents a snow lion.
 
• It is a dance of the Bhutia people.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
